name: smwsprites-minecart
title: Minecart
description:
This sprite will remain stationary until Mario jumps onto it. Then it will start going left or right (depending on its extra bit). The sprite will stop when it hits a wall/an object and will disappear after a few seconds. Overwrites the Mega Mole graphics in SP4.

For further information and customization options, check the ASM file.
